descriptions.assign: Sets local variable values for child statements.
descriptions.assert: Stops evaluation with an error if the condition is false.
descriptions.children: Evaluates all child statements or the children selected by index.
descriptions.circle: Creates a 2D circle from a radius or diameter.
descriptions.color: Sets the preview color and opacity of child geometry.
descriptions.cube: Creates a cube or rectangular solid, optionally centered at the origin.
descriptions.cylinder: Creates a cylinder, cone, or truncated cone along the Z axis.
descriptions.difference: Subtracts the other children from the first child.
descriptions.echo: Writes the supplied values to the OpenSCAD console. Use it to inspect values while debugging a model or expression.
descriptions.hull: Creates the convex hull of the child geometry.
descriptions.import: Loads data from an external file.
descriptions.intersection: Keeps the geometry shared by all children.
descriptions.linear_extrude: Extrudes a 2D shape into a solid, with optional twist and scaling.
descriptions.minkowski: Computes the Minkowski sum of the children.
descriptions.mirror: Reflects the children across the plane perpendicular to the given vector.
descriptions.multmatrix: Applies a transformation matrix to the children.
descriptions.offset: Expands or contracts the outline of a 2D shape.
descriptions.polygon: Creates a 2D polygon from points and optional paths.
descriptions.polyhedron: Creates a 3D solid from vertices and faces.
descriptions.projection: Projects 3D geometry onto the XY plane or takes a cross-section at Z = 0.
descriptions.render: Evaluates child geometry fully, including during preview.
descriptions.resize: Scales the children to the requested dimensions.
descriptions.rotate: Rotates child geometry by angles in degrees.
descriptions.rotate_extrude: Sweeps a 2D profile around the Z axis to create a solid.
descriptions.scale: Scales child geometry along one or more axes.
descriptions.sphere: Creates a sphere from a radius or diameter.
descriptions.surface: Creates a height field from a data file or image.
descriptions.text: Creates 2D geometry from text in the selected font.
descriptions.translate: Moves child geometry by the given vector.
descriptions.union: Combines the children into one geometry.
descriptions.abs: Returns the absolute value of a number.
descriptions.acos: Returns the inverse cosine in degrees.
descriptions.asin: Returns the inverse sine in degrees.
descriptions.atan: Returns the inverse tangent in degrees.
descriptions.atan2: Returns the angle in degrees from the positive X axis to the point (x, y).
descriptions.ceil: Rounds up to the nearest integer.
descriptions.chr: Converts Unicode code points to a string.
descriptions.concat: Concatenates values and lists into a single list.
descriptions.cos: Returns the cosine of an angle in degrees.
descriptions.cross: Computes the cross product of two vectors.
descriptions.dxf_cross: Reads two intersecting lines from a DXF file and returns their intersection.
descriptions.dxf_dim: Reads a named dimension from a DXF file.
descriptions.exp: Returns e raised to the given power.
descriptions.floor: Rounds down to the nearest integer.
descriptions.is_bool: Tests whether the value is a Boolean.
descriptions.is_function: Tests whether the value is a function.
descriptions.is_list: Tests whether the value is a list.
descriptions.is_num: Tests whether the value is a number.
descriptions.is_string: Tests whether the value is a string.
descriptions.is_undef: Tests whether the value is undefined.
descriptions.len: Returns the length of a string or list.
descriptions.lookup: Looks up a value in a table, interpolating between neighboring entries.
descriptions.norm: Returns the Euclidean length of a vector.
descriptions.ord: Returns the Unicode code point of the first character.
descriptions.parent_module: Returns the name of a module in the current call stack.
descriptions.pow: Raises the base to the given exponent.
descriptions.rands: Returns a list of random numbers within the specified bounds, with an optional seed.
descriptions.search: Finds the indices of matching entries in a string or list.
descriptions.sign: Returns -1, 0, or 1 according to the sign of the number.
descriptions.sin: Returns the sine of an angle in degrees.
descriptions.str: Converts the supplied values to strings and concatenates them.
descriptions.tan: Returns the tangent of an angle in degrees.
descriptions.version: Returns the OpenSCAD version as a list.
descriptions.version_num: Returns the OpenSCAD version as a number.
descriptions.fill: Fills enclosed holes in child geometry.
descriptions.textmetrics: Returns size and positioning metrics for a string of text.
descriptions.fontmetrics: Returns metrics for the selected font.
descriptions.fragments: Returns the number of segments used to approximate a circle.
descriptions.object: Creates an object from named values.
descriptions.roof: Creates a roof over a 2D footprint.
